title: Rate limits and overload responses
summary: Request limiting can reject or delay traffic according to configured rates and bursts. Rejection status is configurable, so 503 or 429 cannot uniquely prove rate limiting.
checks: Compare approved limiting metadata, request timing and upstream route evidence.
limitations: No production load generation or limit-policy changes are executed.
